Määrät ovat Hankintayksikköä sitomattomia arvioita. normalized.title: Ireland – Survey services – Habitat Mapping and Habitat Condition Assessments of the Inch Spit within Páirc Náisiunta na Mara Ciarrai
normalized.description: In summary, the Services comprise: a new habitat mapping and habitat condition assessment surveys of Inch Spit, County Kerry, using existing and/or novel technologies as appropriate. This is to both update and improve our understanding of the occurrence and distribution of the habitats found here. Habitats at this site were last mapped in 2007-2008 during the Saltmarsh Monitoring Project and in 2004-2006 as part of the Coastal Monitoring Project – please see supporting documents for Castlemaine Harbour SAC for details of these studies: https://www.npws.ie/protected-sites/sac/000343.
